camera.height: exact eye level, perpendicular to the wall behind

lens.dof: deep focus keeping every plane sharp

lighting.practicals: shadows are minimal so surfaces read as flat colour fields

palette.grade: warm pastel, evenly saturated across the frame

rules: subject dead centre facing the lens
composition.movement_of_subject: subjects move in straight lines, parallel or perpendicular to the frame edge

sound.ambience_bias: clean quiet interiors with crisp isolated object sounds

music.instrumentation: A plucked acoustic guitar with tambourine and a simple bass line
music.dynamics: steady and unvarying from start to finish

must_include: the subject is centred and faces the lens directly
the background wall sits parallel to the frame

notes: Frontal symmetry, flat pastel colour, deliberate whip pans. Every element is squared to the frame.
